description.text: In one continuous take, the black sports car with a carbon fibre body pulls forward out of deep darkness and onto the empty showroom floor. The opening is almost black, with only a thin edge of polished floor catching a sliver of light. As the car advances, showroom light slides across its body, drawing out the long curves and the dark sheen of the carbon fibre panels. Reflections stretch and then shorten along the glossy floor while the surrounding space remains bare, quiet and uncluttered. The car moves with a steady, deliberate glide, holding a measured pace as the shadows fall behind it. Near the end of the take, the motion settles into the complete supplied final frame: the full showroom view of the black sports car on the empty floor, with the car's position, proportions, body finish and surrounding floor kept exactly as supplied. The lighting remains cool and cinematic, with soft highlights along the car and a clean falloff into the background. A low engine note and the whisper of tyres carry the advance, while a restrained sustained synth score stays low beneath the sound. No people enter the space, and no additional objects or lettering appear.
